svg.title: Concavity, tangent lines and a point of inflection
svg.desc: Top: f(x) = x cubed minus 3x squared plus 2 with short blue tangent lines. For x < 1 the graph is concave down and its tangent lines lie above it; for x > 1 it is concave up and its tangent lines lie below it. The point of inflection is (1, 0). Bottom, on the same x-scale: f'(x) = 3x squared minus 6x, decreasing for x < 1 and increasing for x > 1, with its lowest point at x = 1, where f''(x) = 6x - 6 changes sign.
